title: Crispy Boudin Bites with Tagine Aioli
description: Crispy bites of boudin served with a creamy tagine aioli, perfect as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
2. Cut the boudin into small cubes.
3. In a bowl, mix together the cornstarch, eggs, and milk.
4. Dip each boudin cube into the cornstarch mixture, coating completely.
5. Roll the coated boudin cube in the breadcrumbs to coat.
6. Fry the coated boudin in the hot oil for 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown.
7. Remove the fried boudin from the oil and drain on paper towels.
8. Make the tagine aioli by mixing together the tagine, garlic, and lemon juice.
9. Serve the crispy boudin bites with the tagine aioli for dipping.
